analysis:
The PR changes two call sites in provider-swift/Sources/ProviderCore/ProviderLoop+InferenceHandler.swift: line 135 (throwIfRefusingNewLocalWork) and line 513 (authoritative autopilot admission check before requestToModel registration). Both swap autopilotAllowsModel(modelId) for autopilotServesModel(modelId). Nothing else in the file changed. The surrounding admission flow is unchanged: decrypt with keyPair, drain checks, fast admission, authoritative re-check with no await before requestToModel registration, then inferenceAccepted. The response path still fails closed on encryption errors (emitSSE, T-008). Cache scope is still taken from the coordinator-authenticated scope, not from caller fields (T-041).

The definition of autopilotServesModel is not in the supplied evidence, so I cannot confirm its semantics. The open question is whether it is at least as restrictive as autopilotAllowsModel. If it were looser, for example by serving models outside the autopilot-selected set or while a placement is pending, a coordinator-routed request could reach an unselected model. That would be a capacity/availability concern rather than a confidentiality or authorization break, because decryption, per-request sender keys and the cache scope are untouched. The explicit autopilotCommand != nil and autopilotManagesResidency && modelSlots[modelId] == nil guards remain at line 513, and the local path keeps its autopilotCommand check.

This is a rename or semantic split with no visible regression, and I raise no finding. The next pass should check the autopilotServesModel implementation and its callers elsewhere in the PR, including that the local and network paths still reject models outside the selected set, and that no other caller of autopilotAllowsModel was left inconsistent.
